findings.issue: Route totals exclude quest time. Every quest step carries 0 hours because no verified fact gives quest durations (plan assumption; no quest step has est_hours). Safest has 2 quest steps (S01, S02); balanced 7 (S01-S06, S12). The 228.2 / 222.86 h totals are training hours only.
findings.recommendation: The guide must state next to every route total: "route totals exclude quest time" and label the totals as training hours.

findings.issue: The safest-vs-balanced gap (228.2 - 222.86 = 5.34 h) is not a like-for-like time saving. It decomposes into 4.29 h from Rellekka instead of Pollnivneach at 80-90 (S13 67.193 h vs S11 71.479 h) and 1.05 h less Falador training (S08 1.046 h vs 2.096 h) because five extra quests (S03, S04, S05, S06, S12) add 28,562 Agility XP at 0 hours. If those quests take more than about 1.05 h in total, the quest block costs time rather than saving it; if they take more than about 5.34 h, balanced is slower overall than safest. No fact gives their durations, so the direction of the comparison cannot be confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Do not present balanced as '5.3 h faster' than safest. Present training hours only, show the decomposition (Rellekka 80-90 saves about 4.3 h of training; the quest block replaces about 1.05 h of Falador training plus unknown quest time), and justify the extra quests by their other value (Rellekka lyre access, Tirannwn, quest Defence) rather than by time.
